purpose: Complete fresh-process FP32/TF32/TF32/FP32 pilot after separately audited logging-only setup repair; distinct from the closed timeout and TF32-only diagnostic.

budget.interpretation: Planning total is about35percent above doubled observed TF32 child duration. Repaired-logging FP32 setup is unmeasured, and no bound or statistical completion guarantee follows. Compile/capture are nested in setup; do not add them. Four phases always follow the fixed schedule until success/failure/global1620s deadline. No data-dependent repeats or selective acceptance.
budget.deadline_policy: One global child deadline; private process-group TERM then KILL, existing recovery wrapper. No per-phase restarts, silent partial completion, resubmission or weakened checks. Supervisor kill/node loss and forced-child buffers remain limitations.

numerics.candidate_change: CUDA matmul allow_tf32=True versus False, legacy setter before compile/capture and restored after phase
numerics.scoring: Original full-vocabulary normalization, beam50, five probabilities, HF clones, constraints, cache/reorder, termination and tie behavior. No batching/layout/workspace/backend/algorithm sweep.

logging: Identical native API logging coverage/level, verified local tmpfs/ext4/xfs sink; disable/flush/hashcopy before measurement and recovery of exactly four phase locations after child exit.

provenance.existing_guard: Measured setup source already hashes and asserts all11release files including model.safetensors before model load. It does not serialize the observed mapping; this is an evidence-reporting limitation, not absence of a runtime checkpoint guard.
provenance.new_record: Emit actual observed release hashes and verification timing from the existing reads before load; audit exact equality to frozen expected.json and equality across phases. Do not copy expected values as observed. Emit explicit structured phase protocol and frozen protocol digest; fix setup-only prose without rewriting old raw evidence.
provenance.resource_hashes: Keep existing quality_resources hashes and held-out row identity checks; no local model load or new large-file hashing for preparation.

timing: Generation includes staging/wrappers/original HF clones. Preparation, extraction, storage scans, profiling, file I/O and setup excluded. Model load separate; compiler/capture nested. Pair user/repeat across ABBA phases; no historical compounded speedup.
audit_required: Normal bounded supervisor exit and exact four-location log recovery
Eight frozen model graphs per phase; zero measured compile/capture
Historical and paired FP32 control exactness, all within-policy warm/direct/graph/repeat/retained/profile outputs and ancestry stable
Original five score storages independent of each other and graph logits
Actual graph-linked TF32 kernel dispatch plus matching native API GEMM shapes/math modes for both lengths in both candidate phases
Output validity, all paired rank/FP32/transition/ancestry evidence; candidate/control differences informative, not rejection by themselves
All latency/memory/per-user/length/half/length-half strata and paired SID metrics/uncertainty

performance_gate.required: Generation median and p95 overall, each length and each half; no median/p95 length-by-half regression
performance_gate.interpretation: Predeclared minimum experimental effect, not user SLO or statistical claim

quality.unit: First matched repeat per unique user; all repeats checked for stability
quality.collision_policy: SID-level only; preserve ambiguity strata; no favorable item expansion
quality.interpretation: Four users cannot establish population parity. No numeric loss margin accepted and no noninferiority inference from nonsignificance.

advancement: Only complete audited control exactness/stability/ownership/dispatch/validity and original material-performance gate can support designing a separate full500 review. No full500 profile or automatic promotion. Large-cohort bootstrap only allocated compute.
remaining: Implement explicit protocol/observed-release provenance without generation or measured-loop AST changes
